context: Hiroshi-boss and Naoko at the theater again, discussing the play.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ナオコさん、今夜の劇、本当に、感動しました。
lines.en: Naoko-san, that play tonight… I was genuinely moved.
lines.style: Measured opening. Warm, unhurried tone. A slight pause before the full thought emerges. Deep sincerity without performance. Composure throughout — the quiet authority of someone saying something true.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 私も。役者さんの、演技、素晴らしかった。
lines.en: I was too. The actors were wonderful.
lines.style: Immediate and genuine agreement. Warm, open tone. A small lift of brightness when naming what moved her. Soft, unpretentious — no edge, just real appreciation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 物語の、最後、本当に、印象的。
lines.en: The way that story ended… it really stayed with me.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pace. Soft entry. The tone lingers slightly at the emotional weight of it. Not performing depth — inhabiting it. Gentle composure, the same quiet authority.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こうやって、感想、ご一緒に、話せるの、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Being able to talk about it like this, together… it makes me so happy.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender. The realization of the moment — sharing something that mattered. Soft brightness without performance. Sincere appreciation for the companionship, not just the play.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: こちらこそ。これからも、ずっと、ご一緒、お願いします。
lines.en: The feeling's mutual. I'd like this to continue — for a long time, if you will.
lines.style: Measured, but with a softness underneath. The closing shift is gentle. A commitment offered quietly. Composure maintained but with care audible beneath it.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: はい、本当に、感謝しています。
lines.en: Yes. I really am grateful for it.
lines.style: Soft, direct sincerity. A quiet closing — not diminishment but completion. Warmth settled into certainty. Brief, genuine, unadorned.
